description: Source code for a Sphinx documentation formatter for behave step definitions, including classes for module management, document generation, and formatter integration.

classes.name: StepsModule
classes.description: Helper class to track step definitions belonging to the same module, providing properties for module name, filename, and documentation.

classes.name: SphinxStepsDocumentGenerator
classes.description: Generates Sphinx-based documentation for step definitions, including methods for creating documents, writing overviews, and formatting step details.

classes.name: SphinxStepsFormatter
classes.description: Main formatter class that integrates with behave to produce Sphinx documentation for registered step definitions.

methods.name: describe_step_definition
methods.description: Returns a formatted string describing a step definition, including step type and pattern.

methods.name: ensure_destdir_exists
methods.description: Ensures the destination directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ensure_document_is_closed
methods.description: Closes the current document if open and not in stdout mode.

methods.name: discover_step_modules
methods.description: Discovers and groups step definitions by module.

methods.name: create_document
methods.description: Creates a new document for output, either in stdout or in a file.

methods.name: write_docs
methods.description: Generates documentation for all step modules.

methods.name: write_step_module_index
methods.description: Writes the index page for step modules.

methods.name: write_step_module
methods.description: Writes documentation for a specific step module.

methods.name: write_step_module_overview
methods.description: Creates an overview table of step definitions.

methods.name: make_step_definition_index_id
methods.description: Generates an index ID for a step definition for cross-referencing.

methods.name: make_step_definition_doc
methods.description: Retrieves or defaults the documentation string for a step.

methods.name: write_step_definition
methods.description: Writes detailed documentation for a single step definition.
